mindMap.caption: to look for a way through

story: After a heavy snowfall, a woman cleared a narrow way along the house.
Then a husky squeezed past her and was the first to use it.
Inside, a man just pointed through the window and showed her the way!
notes: Scene detector top scores (0.04/3.96 s) are camera moves, no cut. The man inside points through the window at 0.2-2.7 s; the woman inside does not point. Dog leaves the frame at 3.7 s (live:2 has off there).
